question: With what offerings and means should worship be performed in relation to the fire pits?
premises: Offerings beginning with foot-water are used
Worship is directed in relation to the fire pits
inference: One should worship thoroughly with foot-water and so forth, by this very means, in relation to the fire pits.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of kuṇḍebhyaḥ (ablative) is context-dependent.
plain_english: One should worship thoroughly with foot-water and so forth, by this very means, in relation to the fire pits.
